initialize_laser_tokenizer: initialize a LASER tokenizer with initialize_tokenizer for a given model directory and laser version
tokenize_sentence: tokenize a sentence using the LASER tokenizer tokenize method to get BPE token output
tokenize_file: tokenize an input text file and write results to an output file using tokenize_file
initialize_laser_encoder: initialize a LASER sentence encoder with initialize_encoder for a given model directory and language
encode_sentences_with_pipeline: encode sentences into embeddings using LaserEncoderPipeline with optional normalization for a given language
